blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future traffic states and driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving in intelligent transportation systems. However, their action learning remains dominated by expert-trajectory imitation, leaving unsafe alternatives close to expert trajectories insufficiently constrained. To improve WAM robustness in safety-critical scenarios, we propose NegWAM, a safety post-training framework for unified WAMs that learns explicit safety boundaries from near-expert failure trajectories. NegWAM constructs negative trajectories that are geometrically close to the expert trajectory yet carry safety risks, uses them as repulsive anchors to steer predictions away from dangerous behavior, and encodes them as scene-conditioned rider tokens to learn scene--trajectory compatibility. During training, NegWAM jointly optimizes the flow-matching and near-expert negative objectives, while the auxiliary rider branch is discarded at inference, incurring no additional overhead. On NAVSIM v2, NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard, a 4.1% relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest. These results demonstrate that NegWAM achieves strong performance in safety-critical scenarios while preserving routine-driving performance. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further demonstrates cross-benchmark generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/Zizizi-hao/NegWAM.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)联合模拟未来交通状态和驾驶行动,以便在智能交通系统中实现端到端的自主驾驶. 然而,他们的动作学习仍然以专家-弹射学模仿为主,使得接近专家轨迹的不安全替代品没有受到足够的制约. 为了提高WAM在安全关键情景中的稳健性,我们提议NegWAM,这是统一WAM的安全培训后框架,从近专家故障轨迹中吸取明确的安全界限。 NegWAM构造了几何接近专家轨迹但带有安全风险的负轨迹,用它们作为反推锚来引导预测远离危险行为,并将它们编码为场景条件的骑手标志,以学习场景-弹射兼容性. 在培训期间,NegWAM联合优化了流动匹配和近专家负面目标,而辅助骑手分支则被推论丢弃,不会引起额外的间接费用. 在NAVSIM v2上,NegWAM在Navhard上实现了40.4 EPDMS,比比较最强的无记分器WAM基线有4.1%的相对改进,在Navest上实现了93.3 EPDMS. 这些结果表明,NegWAM在安全关键情景下取得了强劲的性能,同时保持了例行驾驶性能. 对HUGSIM的零镜头闭路评价进一步展现了跨基准通用. 该代码可在https://github.com/Zizizizi-hao/NegWAM上查阅.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems typically learn driving policies from large-scale expert demonstrations and perform well in routine scenarios [ 1 , 2 ] . However, hazardous behaviors and failure cases are scarce in real-world driving data, making it difficult for imitation learning to acquire explicit safety boundaries [ 3 , 4 ] . World-action models (WAMs) introduce stronger priors over scene dynamics into end-to-end autonomous driving by predicting future world states and leveraging future representations to guide planning [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Yet their action branches are still trained primarily through flow matching on expert trajectories. This supervision tells the model what to imitate, but not which near-expert alternatives should be rejected as unsafe. Consequently, stronger world modeling alone does not establish explicit safety boundaries, motivating safety-oriented post-training for WAMs.
blocks.zh: 端到端自主驾驶系统一般从大型专家示范中学习驾驶政策,在常规情景中表现良好[1,2]. 然而,在现实世界的驱动数据中,危险行为和故障案例很少,使得模仿学习难以获得明确的安全界限[3,4]. 世界行动模式(WAMs)通过预测未来世界国家并利用未来的表述来指导规划[5,6,7],将更强先于场地动态引入端到端的自主驱动. 然而,它们的行动分支仍然主要通过在专家轨道上的流量匹配来培训。 这种监督告诉模型应该模仿什么,但不应该以不安全为由拒绝哪些近乎专家的替代办法。 因此,单靠更强大的世界模型并不能确定明确的安全界限,从而推动为WAM进行面向安全的培训。

blocks.en: Post-training offers a natural avenue beyond these limitations, but a central challenge is constructing learning signals that faithfully encode desired driving behavior [ 8 , 4 ] . Existing methods primarily rely on two sources of supervision. One line of work (Figure 1 a) explores policies in closed-loop environments built with a simulator [ 9 , 10 ] or a world model [ 11 , 12 ] , but is constrained by the sim-to-real gap, environment construction costs, and reconstruction artifacts [ 13 , 12 ] . Another line (Figure 1 b) scores candidate trajectories using rule-based evaluators or learned reward models, but the quality of its supervision is limited by handcrafted rules, privileged information, and evaluator bias [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] . These limitations underscore the need for additional sources of effective supervision for autonomous driving post-training.
blocks.zh: 后培训提供了超越这些限制的自然途径,但一个中心挑战是构建学习信号,忠实地将所期望的驱动行为编码 [8, 4]. 现有方法主要依靠两个监督来源。 一行工作(图1a)探索了以模拟器[9,10]或世界模型[11,12]所建的封闭式落地环境中的政策,但受实际差距,环境建设成本,重建文物[13,12]的限制. 另一行(图1b)使用基于规则的评价员或学到的奖励模式对候选人的轨迹进行评分,但其监督质量受到手工规则、特权信息和评价员偏见[14、15、16]的限制。 这些限制突出表明,有必要为自主驾驶后培训提供更多的有效监督来源。

blocks.en: Unsafe driving behaviors provide critical cues for delineating safety boundaries and are often easier to characterize than the full range of desirable driving behavior [ 17 , 18 ] . Building on this insight, we propose NegWAM , a negative-aware safety post-training method that incorporates offline negative supervision into a unified WAM (Figure 1 c). Specifically, near-expert negatives serve as repulsive anchors that mark locally unsafe regions in trajectory space and as scene-conditioned rider tokens that enable shared attention layers to learn scene–trajectory compatibility. Together with the original imitation objective, these mechanisms enable the WAM to learn not only how experts drive but also which behaviors should be avoided in the current scene.
blocks.zh: 不安全的驾驶行为为划定安全界限提供了关键的提示,而且往往比各种理想的驾驶行为更容易定性[17,18]. 基于这一见解,我们提议NegWAM,一种负面认识的安全培训后方法,将线下负面监督纳入统一的WAM(图1c)。 具体来说,近专家的负片充当了在轨迹空间中标出当地不安全区域的反感锚地,以及使共同关注层能够学习场景-弹射相容性的场景-场景-场景相容性的地标。 这些机制连同最初的模仿目标,使得WAM不仅能够学会专家如何驱动,而且能够学会在当前场景中应该避免哪些行为.

blocks.en: Unlike prior hard-negative learning that primarily regularizes planner outputs [ 17 ] , NegWAM post-trains both the single-rollout action flow and the shared world–action representation of a unified WAM. It mines near-expert trajectories that fail offline safety evaluation and jointly optimizes the original flow-matching objective with two hard-negative objectives. The evaluator is used only for offline mining, while the rider branch and compatibility head are removed at inference, adding no inference-time modules. On NAVSIM v2 [ 19 , 20 ] , NegWAM achieves 40.4 EPDMS on navhard , a 4.1 % relative improvement over the strongest compared scorer-free WAM baseline, and achieves 93.3 EPDMS on navtest , surpassing the strongest baseline score of 92.9 by 0.4 points and demonstrating stronger challenging-scenario performance without compromising routine driving. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM [ 21 ] further supports cross-benchmark transfer, with NegWAM achieving a higher HD-Score than DriveWAM (30.6 vs. 27.2).
blocks.zh: NegWAM与以往主要规范规划者产出的硬阴性学习不同[17],NegWAM在进入后既关注单一推出行动流动,也关注共享的世界-行动代表一个统一的WAM. 它埋设了不合格下线安全评价的近专家轨迹并联合优化了原有的流量比对目标,有两个硬负目标. 评估员仅用于离线开采,而骑手分支和相容头则被推想取出,不添加推想时间模块. 在NAVSIM v2 [19, 20]上,NegWAM在导航上实现了40.4 EPDMS, 相对比最强的无分数WAM基线改善4.1%, 在导航测试上实现了93.3 EPDMS, 超过最强的基准分92.9分0.4分, 并在不损害常规行驶的情况下展现出更强大的挑战性场景性能. 对HUGSIM[21]的零镜头闭路评价进一步支持跨基准传输,NegWAM实现比DriveWAM更高的HD-分数(30.6 vs 27.2).

blocks.en: In summary, our key contributions are as follows: • We revisit unified world–action models through safety post-training, showing that augmenting flow-matching imitation with near-expert negative supervision improves challenging-scenario performance without compromising routine driving. • We propose NegWAM, a near-expert negative safety post-training method for WAMs that jointly optimizes the original flow-matching objective and two complementary near-expert negative objectives without introducing additional inference-time overhead. • We introduce two complementary near-expert negative mechanisms. Repulsive anchors push predictions away from locally unsafe trajectories, while scene-conditioned rider tokens enable the unified WAM to determine whether a trajectory is compatible with the current scene.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们重新审视统一的世界-通过安全培训后的行动模式,这表明,通过近专家负面监督来增强流动匹配的模仿,在不损害常规驾驶的情况下,改进了具有挑战性的情景表现。 我们提议NegWAM,这是WAM的近专家负面安全培训后方法,它联合优化了最初的流量匹配目标和两个互补的近专家负面目标,但没有引入额外的推断时间管理费。 我们采用了两个相辅相成的近专家负面机制。 反向锚将预测推离了当地不安全的轨迹,而场景条件化的骑手符使统一的WAM能够确定一个轨迹是否与当前场景相容.

blocks.zh: 我们通过安全后培训来重新审视统一的世界行动模式,这表明在不破坏常规驾驶的情况下,通过接近专家的负面监督来增加流动匹配的模仿可以改善挑战性的情景表现。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work on end-to-end autonomous driving, world–action models, and policy post-training. Section III introduces NegWAM, including its core components and training objective. Section IV evaluates its planning performance and zero-shot closed-loop generalization, with ablation studies and supporting analyses. Section V summarizes the main findings and discusses limitations and future directions.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查有关端到端自主驾驶、世界行动模式和政策培训后的相关工作。 第三节介绍NegWAM,包括其核心组成部分和培训目标。 第四节评价其规划性能和零发闭路通化,并进行通化研究和辅助分析. 节次 五总结了主要调查结果并讨论了局限性和未来方向。

blocks.en: II-A End-to-End Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: II-A 端到端自主驾驶

blocks.en: End-to-end autonomous driving maps sensory observations to planned trajectories through a learned policy [ 2 , 22 ] . Joint optimization connects scene understanding with planning and reduces information loss across separately designed modules [ 1 ] . Scaling driving data further improves the coverage of learned behavior [ 23 ] , while generative future prediction introduces temporal structure and motion priors into policy learning [ 24 , 25 ] . These developments strengthen the policy’s ability to represent traffic scenes and reproduce expert decisions across diverse driving conditions.
blocks.zh: 通过有学问的政策对计划轨迹进行端到端的自主驱动地图感知观测[2,22]. 联合优化将场景理解与规划相接,并减少不同设计模块的信息损失[1]. 扩展驱动数据进一步提高了对所学行为的涵盖范围[23],而遗传性的未来预测将时间结构和运动前科引入了政策学习[24,25]. 这些事态发展加强了该政策在各种驾驶条件中代表交通场景和复制专家决定的能力。

blocks.en: Expert demonstrations nevertheless provide an uneven account of driving behavior: successful maneuvers are abundant, whereas safety-critical failures and recovery interactions are comparatively scarce [ 3 , 12 , 4 ] . Expert-trajectory supervision identifies a desirable action for the observed scene, but supplies few explicit comparisons with nearby unsafe alternatives. Such alternatives are informative because geometric similarity to an expert trajectory does not establish that an action is safe in the same traffic context [ 17 , 26 ] . Learning to distinguish these alternatives introduces a specific supervision requirement beyond reproducing the demonstrated trajectory.
blocks.zh: 然而,专家的演示对驱动行为作了不均衡的描述:成功的操作非常多,而安全关键故障和恢复互动相对较少[3、12、4]。 专家弹道监督为观测到的场景确定了一种可取的行动,但很少能与附近的不安全替代品进行明确的比较。 这种替代方法具有信息性,因为与专家轨迹的几何相近性不能确定在同一交通环境下某项行动是安全的[17、26]。 学习如何区分这些替代品,除了复制所证明的轨迹之外,还引入了具体的监督要求。

blocks.en: II-B World-Action Models for Driving
blocks.zh: II-B 驾驶世界行动模式

blocks.en: Pretrained video generative models provide temporal and motion priors that can be transferred to action learning [ 27 , 5 , 7 ] . Their role in driving has expanded from supporting scene synthesis and simulation [ 11 , 28 ] to providing future representations for trajectory prediction [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . Recent approaches further couple future visual modeling with action generation, bringing anticipated scene evolution into the policy’s prediction process [ 5 , 32 , 6 ] . This progression makes world modeling increasingly relevant to how driving actions are represented and generated.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视频基因模型提供了时间和运动前传,可以被转移到动作学习[27,5,7]. 它们在驾驶中的作用从支持场景合成和模拟[11,28]扩大到为轨迹预测提供未来表现[29,30,31]. 最近的方法进一步将未来的视觉模型与行动生成结合起来,将预期的场景演变纳入政策的预测过程[5、32、6]。 这一进展使世界的模型越来越适合如何体现和产生驱动行动。

blocks.en: Recent work [ 7 , 33 ] realizes this coupling through shared video–action transformers trained using flow matching. Such architectures allow action supervision to shape the shared world–action representations. Their training objectives, however, focus on fitting demonstrated video–action sequences without explicitly contrasting expert trajectories with undesirable alternatives. This raises the question of how negative trajectories can provide supervision for both action generation and scene–trajectory compatibility during safety post-training.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作[7,33]通过共享的视频-动作变压器实现这种耦合,使用流配. 这样的架构可以让行动监督塑造共同的世界-行动表现. 然而,他们的培训目标侧重于安装显示的视频-动作序列,而没有明确地将专家的轨迹与不可取的替代办法相提并论。 这就提出了一个问题,即负轨迹如何在安全训练后为动作生成和场景-弹射相容性提供监督。

blocks.en: II-C Post-Training for Driving
blocks.zh: 驾驶培训后

blocks.en: Driving policy post-training introduces feedback beyond expert matching through simulated rollouts, reward-based optimization, and trajectory preferences [ 3 , 4 ] . Closed-loop learning uses synthetic simulators such as CARLA [ 9 , 34 ] , reconstructed scenes, or learned environments to expose policies to the consequences of their actions [ 13 , 12 ] . These mechanisms often overlap: DreamerAD [ 14 ] combines latent-world rollouts with learned reward feedback, while WorldRFT [ 15 ] uses collision-aware rewards for reinforcement fine-tuning. Complementary to policy post-training, TOAD [ 16 ] uses a learned trajectory scorer to guide test-time search without retraining the policy.
blocks.zh: 推动政策培训后,通过模拟推出、基于奖励的优化和轨迹偏好,提供超出专家匹配的反馈[3、4]。 闭路学习使用CARLA等合成模拟器[9,34],重建场景,或被学习到的环境来使政策暴露出其行动的后果[13,12]. 这些机制经常重叠: DreamerAD [14] 将潜入世界的推出与学到的奖励反馈相结合,而WorldRFT [15] 则使用碰撞感知奖励来进行加固微调. 作为对政策后培训的补充,TOAD[16]使用有学识的轨迹计分器来指导测试时间的搜索,而不对政策进行再培训.

blocks.en: Preference-based methods express the additional supervision through comparisons between trajectories. TakeAD [ 35 ] derives preferences from expert takeover data. DriveDPO [ 26 ] combines imitation similarity with rule-based safety scores for policy learning, then applies Safety DPO using human-like but unsafe rejected trajectories. Its preference construction thus retains explicit safety evaluation without requiring a separately trained reward model. BeyondDrive [ 17 ] develops this failure-based perspective through a flow-matching generator, expert-proximity and safety filtering, and a repulsive distance loss defined on predicted trajectories. These studies establish the value of near-expert failures as supervision, with distinct choices of policy objective and negative construction.
blocks.zh: 基于优惠的方法通过轨迹的比较来表达额外的监督. TakeAD[35]从专家收购数据中获得偏好. DriveDPO [26] 将模仿相似性与基于规则的安全分数结合用于政策学习,再使用类似人但不安全被否决的轨迹应用安全DPO. 因此,其首选建筑保留了明确的安全评价,不需要经过单独培训的奖励模式。 Beyond Drive [17]通过流相相相配的生成器,专家相相相相相相相接和安全滤取来开发出这种以故障为主的视角,并在所预测的轨迹上定义了可逆相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相接的相相相相相相接. 这些研究确定了近专家失败作为监督的价值,并明确了政策目标和负面构思的选择。

blocks.en: For a unified WAM, an unsafe alternative is both a trajectory to avoid and an example of incompatibility between the scene and an action. NegWAM learns these two aspects from the same offline-mined failures: repulsive anchors supervise the generated action trajectory, while rider tokens expose the expert and negative trajectories to the observed scene through shared attention for compatibility learning. The original flow-matching objective remains active throughout post-training. Safety evaluation supplies the offline negative labels; subsequent optimization internalizes this supervision in the WAM, and the auxiliary rider branch is removed at inference.
blocks.zh: 对于一个统一的WAM来说,一个不安全的替代品既是一个可避免的轨迹,也是一个场景与动作不相容的例子. NegWAM从相同的离线失败中学习出这两个方面:反向锚能监督所生成的动作轨迹,而骑手符能通过对相容性学习的共同关注来将专家和负向轨迹暴露出被观测到的场景. 最初的流量匹配目标在整个培训后始终是积极的。 安全评价提供离线负标签;随后优化在WAM中将这种监管内部化,辅助骑手分会根据推论被去掉.

blocks.en: III Methods
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: NegWAM post-trains a unified world–action model using scene-specific failures close to expert trajectories. Each retained failure supplies two related learning signals: a motion to avoid during action generation and a scene–trajectory pair to distinguish from the expert. Figure 2 illustrates how repulsive anchors and scene-conditioned rider tokens introduce these signals into the same backbone while retaining its flow-matching objective.
blocks.zh: NegWAM后传 使用接近专家轨迹的场景特异性故障的统一世界-行动模型. 每个保留故障都提供了两个相关的学习信号:在动作生成期间避免的运动和与专家区分的场景-弹射对. 图2说明了反向锚和场景条件的骑手道具如何将这些信号引入同一主干,同时保留其流量匹配目标.

blocks.en: III-A Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 三-A 初步情况

blocks.en: III-A 1 Unified World–Action Model
blocks.zh: III-A 1 世界统一行动模式

blocks.en: To couple future scene modeling with action generation in one backbone, we adopt a unified world–action architecture [ 27 , 7 ] built on a pretrained video backbone [ 36 ] as the base model. A training sample comprises a current camera image ℐ obs \mathcal{I}^{\mathrm{obs}} , future visual targets ℐ fut \mathcal{I}^{\mathrm{fut}} , an expert trajectory τ + \tau^{+} , and navigation and ego-state conditions including four historical ego poses. A frozen causal video VAE encodes the observed and future frames into the clean visual stream 𝐱 0 v \mathbf{x}_{0}^{v} . blocks.en: As shown in Table IV , continuing post-training without either proposed component yields 38.2 EPDMS, only 0.5 points above the pretrained baseline. Introducing repulsive anchors increases EPDMS to 39.1, outperforming the matched post-training control and pretrained baseline by 0.9 and 1.4 points, respectively. blocks.en: As shown in Figure 7 , NegWAM maintains safer clearance than DriveWAM [ 7 ] and avoids potential collision regions. In the second scenario, an occupant of a roadside parked vehicle opens the door and begins to exit. DriveWAM [ 7 ] still produces a nominal close-passing trajectory, leaving insufficient clearance for this emerging hazard. After post-training, NegWAM instead shifts outward and maintains a safe distance from the parked vehicle. Although the baseline trajectory may be safe without the door-opening interaction, it entails substantial risk in this safety-critical context. This comparison suggests that NegWAM internalizes scene-dependent safety boundaries that are difficult to capture through expert imitation alone, enabling it to avoid trajectories that are geometrically close to expert behavior yet potentially unsafe.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We revisit unified world–action models from the perspective of safety post-training and introduce NegWAM to address their reliance on expert imitation and lack of explicit safety boundaries. NegWAM leverages offline-constructed, near-expert hard-negative trajectories as repulsive anchors and scene-conditioned rider tokens, internalizing scene-dependent safety boundaries at both the trajectory and representation levels. Experiments demonstrate that NegWAM improves robustness in challenging scenarios while preserving routine driving performance, without requiring online simulation during post-training or introducing additional inference overhead. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation further validates the transferability of these learned safety boundaries to unseen interactive environments.
blocks.zh: 我们从安全培训后的角度重新审视统一的世界行动模式,并引入NegWAM来解决他们对专家模仿和缺乏明确安全界限的依赖。 NegWAM将线下构造的,近乎专家的硬负式轨迹作为可回击锚和场景条件化的骑手道具,在轨迹和代表级别上将视地安全界限内部化. 实验表明,NegWAM提高了挑战情景中的稳健性,同时保留了日常驾驶性能,而无需在培训后进行在线模拟或引入额外的推论间接费用. 零镜头闭路评价进一步验证了这些所学出的安全界限可转移到看不见的互动环境.

blocks.en: The generalization of NegWAM to the diversity and unpredictability of real-world driving remains to be established. Learning safety boundaries that remain effective across evolving environments and complex traffic interactions is a broader challenge for world–action models. Future work will investigate more generalizable and adaptive safety learning paradigms, toward integrating predictive world understanding with reliable long-horizon decision-making for autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: NegWAM对现实世界驱动的多样性和不可预测性的概括尚待确定。 对世界行动模式而言,学习在不断变化的环境和复杂的交通互动中依然有效的安全界限是一个更广泛的挑战。 今后的工作将研究更加笼统和适应性更强的安全学习模式,将预测性的世界理解与可靠的自主驾驶长期决策结合起来。

blocks.en: A-D Scope of the Negative Supervision

blocks.en: The learned safety boundary depends on the near-expert failures covered by the fixed trajectory vocabulary. Rare maneuvers and interactions outside that candidate space receive no direct negative supervision. Vocabulary-based retrieval provides broad trajectory coverage but limited adaptation to individual scenes [ 40 ] ; diversity-aware failure generation is a complementary direction [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 所学出的安全分界线取决于固定轨迹词汇所覆盖的近专家失误. 在候选空间之外很少进行操纵和互动,没有受到直接的负面监督。 基于词汇的检索可提供广阔的轨迹覆盖面,但对单个场景的适应性有限[40];多样性-意识故障生成是一个互补方向[17].

blocks.en: The zero-EPDMS criterion assigns a common failure label to different violation types and severities. Both hard-negative objectives therefore inherit the offline evaluator’s assumptions. ADE additionally measures geometric proximity rather than interaction risk: similar paths can have different outcomes depending on timing, relative velocity, and road geometry [ 19 ] . The rider branch uses scene context, but its negative labels still come from this same construction process.
blocks.zh: 0-EPDMS标准为不同的违反类型和断裂指定了常见的故障标签. 因此,两个硬负目标都继承了离线评价者的假设。 ADE另外测量几何相近程度而不是相互作用的风险:相近路径可以根据时间、相对速度和道路几何情况产生不同的结果[19]。 骑手分会使用场景上下文,但其负面标签仍出自同一种构造过程.

blocks.en: The additional failure cases show that benchmark gains can coexist with unsafe individual decisions. The evidence remains benchmark-based and provides no formal safety guarantee. Deployment requires independent closed-loop validation, evaluation across traffic conditions and road-user categories, and safeguards for hazardous or unfamiliar situations.
blocks.zh: 其他失败案例表明,基准收益可以与不安全的个人决定并存。 证据仍然是以基准为基础的,没有提供正式的安全保障。 部署需要独立的封闭式舱位验证、跨交通条件和道路使用者类别的评价,以及对危险或不熟悉情况的保障措施。
